title: Finiteness and radiciality of the scalar-extended scheme Frobenius
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], so $a\geq1$, $q=p^a$, $k_0$ has $q$ elements and $k$ is its fixed algebraic closure. Let $X_0$ be a $k_0$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-over-base] of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let

$$
\Phi=\operatorname{Fr}^{(q)}_{X_0}\times_{k_0}\operatorname{id}_k:X\longrightarrow X
$$

be the scalar-extended $q$-power Frobenius of [def-weil-relative-frobenius-geometric-fiber], whose affine ring map is $u\otimes b\mapsto u^q\otimes b$. Then $\Phi$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and radicial [def-weil-radicial-morphism]. No separatedness or reducedness assumption is imposed on $X_0$.

source.place: Tag 0CCD, label lemma-relative-frobenius-finite; Tag 0CCB, label lemma-relative-frobenius; Tag 0CCG, label remark-n-fold-relative-frobenius. Apply to the a-fold relative Frobenius over k_0, whose q-power Frobenius is the identity, then extend scalars to k.

proof.text: Let F be the constructed p^a-power absolute Frobenius of X_0 [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme], using model_characteristic from [def-weil-relative-frobenius-geometric-fiber]. Verify the source-library predicate F.IsFrobenius (Nat.card k_0). For t : Spec R -> X_0 and any cardinality-power endomorphism phi of R, naturality t F = F_R t is equality on points and on each open is exactly map_pow for t.app U. The global-sections adjunction GammaSpecIso identifies F_R with Spec.map phi: its inverse preserves powers and Nat.card k_0 = q = p^a. These computations prove the predicate for every affine test scheme, including the empty one.

Use the already proved source-library candidates recorded on this node, Scheme.Hom.IsFrobenius.isFinite_of_isPullback and Scheme.Hom.IsFrobenius.isUniversalHomeomorphism_of_isPullback, with k = k_0 and the predicate established in step 1. The chosen pullback square is X = X_0 x_{Spec k_0} Spec k [def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-base-change]. Its required compatibility equations are exactly relativeFrobenius_projections [def-weil-relative-frobenius-geometric-fiber]. The given locally finite type hypothesis [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] supplies the sole finiteness hypothesis. These source theorems already prove the affine finiteness and universal-homeomorphism argument and its base-change stability [lem-trf-finite-radicial-basechange], so no iteration through Frobenius twists is needed.

The source-library IsUniversalHomeomorphism class extends UniversallyInjective, so take its toUniversallyInjective projection [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism, def-weil-radicial-morphism]. Pair this with the finiteness obtained in step 2. The proof adds no separatedness, reducedness or nonemptiness assumption.

proof_origin.place: V7 Lean proof: specialize the already proved candidates in WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Frobenius.lean (isFinite_of_isPullback and isUniversalHomeomorphism_of_isPullback) after proving the IsFrobenius predicate directly by naturality on sections and GammaSpecIso. This uses the absolute Frobenius argument of Tags 0CC7 and 0CC8 and base-change stability, avoiding the general relative-Frobenius iteration of Tags 0CCD and 0CCG.
